request.prompt:
A Python function fails its tests.

Code:
```python
def can_arrange(arr):
    ind=-1
    i=1
    while i<len(arr):
      if arr[i]<arr[i-1]:
        ind=i
      i+=1
      ind-=1
    return ind
```

Test output:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "solution.py", line 33, in <module>
    check(can_arrange)
    ~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "solution.py", line 25, in check
    assert can_arrange([1,2,4,3,5])==3
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError
```

In at most three sentences, state the root cause of the bug. Do not write code.

response.text: The function decrements `ind` on every iteration, so after the loop it no longer holds the index of the first inversion; it ends up being the negative distance from the end of the list. This logic error causes the returned value to be incorrect for the test case.
